title: Construction
description: A fully specified building element: assembly (layer stack) + orientation + surface film resistances. Bridges the material/assembly library and the model edges. R_total [m²·K/W] = R_si + sum(e/λ) + R_se.

examples: Mur vertical pierre de taille 40 cm

assembly_id.description: References an assembly by its id.

orientation.description: Geometric orientation — determines default surface film resistances (ISO 6946).

R_si.description: Interior surface thermal resistance [m²·K/W]. Defaults by orientation: vertical=0.13, horizontal_up=0.10, horizontal_down=0.17 (ISO 6946).

R_se.description: Exterior surface thermal resistance [m²·K/W]. Default 0.04 for all orientations (ISO 6946).
